ns2:section.sectionText: Students in this course will need to register for one lecture and one discussion section, with both having the same starting letter of the section name. Lectures have L as the second character of the name, while discussions have D as the second character. For up-to-date information about statistics course registration, please see our registration update pages: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
